decision: PRODUCT_SCOPE.md remains the canonical product master; shared memory may coordinate work but may not redefine product scope.
Product owner is UI-only for implementation workflows. Agents own coding, terminal, Git, CI, and repository operations and ask the owner only for UI observations or product decisions.
Cursor executes only ACTIVE_TASK.json, must cite GitHub-backed shared memory at task start and completion, cannot self-assign/self-approve/merge, and must stop on scope conflict.
